Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

the comprehensive rollout plan for our monorepo migration to pnpm workspaces and Turborepo.

First, check pnpm-workspace.yaml in the repository root to verify that the packages wildcard includes packages/*, apps/*, and tools/*. Inspect root package.json to confirm that the packageManager field is pinned to pnpm@9.1.0. In packages/ui/src/index.tsx, verify that all shared React components export typed properties with named exports rather than default exports. In apps/web/next.config.js, confirm that the transpilePackages array contains @enterprise/ui and @enterprise/utils. Developers must execute local builds using pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=web... to build the web application and all upstream dependencies. The release coordinator confirmed that semantic release workflows will automatically publish packages to our private npm registry when pull requests merge into main.

The site reliability team requires that bundle size analyzer thresholds in apps/web fail pull requests if the initial JavaScript bundle exceeds 250 KB. In addition, inspect eslint.config.js to verify that ESLint rules enforce import order boundaries prohibiting circular dependencies between workspace packages. Mobile team in apps/mobile, confirm that the React Native Metro bundler configures watch folders to resolve workspace symlinks cleanly. Testing infrastructure in vitest.workspace.ts must execute unit test suites across all packages in parallel using --max-workers=4. Security operations confirmed that pnpm audit --audit-level=high must run on every pull request to block known critical vulnerabilities. All developers should execute pnpm store prune weekly to clear orphaned package tarballs from local storage drives.

The documentation website in apps/docs must compile with Docusaurus 3 using pnpm --filter docs build to verify zero broken markdown links. Ensure that Git hooks managed by Husky in .husky/pre-commit run lint-staged on staged files before allowing commits. In .github/CODEOWNERS, verify that the core platform team is assigned as required code reviewers for pnpm-workspace.yaml and turbo.json. The engineering productivity lead confirmed that cold cache CI build times must remain under 4 minutes and warm cache builds under 90 seconds. Inspect scripts/migrate/cleanup.sh to verify that legacy node_modules and .cache directories are purged before executing the initial pnpm install. Furthermore, developer documentation in docs/guides/monorepo.md must be updated with onboarding instructions and common troubleshooting steps for workspace linking. All developers must install pnpm globally using corepack enable pnpm prior to Monday morning's sprint kickoff.

Furthermore, in package.json add the engines field requiring Node >= 18.0.0 and pnpm >= 9.0.0. The release engineering team requires that Git tag formats use package name at version syntax for multi-package releases. In .npmrc, configure shamefully-hoist to false to guarantee strict dependency isolation across workspace packages. Also configure auto-install-peers to true in .npmrc to avoid manual peer dependency resolutions in component packages. The frontend developer lead confirmed that bundle size limits must be configured for all production packages in packages/ui. All developers must run pnpm dedupe weekly to eliminate duplicate transitive dependencies across workspaces.
